broker.name: Headway
broker.tagline: On its own site since 2023. Its site names FSCA. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Unlimited.
broker.about: Headway says it has operated since 2023. An address it publishes is 3 Flamingo Crescent, Beacon Bay, East London, 5241, South Africa. Account names on its site include Cent, Standard, and Pro. Platforms named there include MT4 and MT5. The site names these regulators: FSCA. The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Unlimited. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.headquarters: 3 Flamingo Crescent, Beacon Bay, East London, 5241, South Africa
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. FSCA: JAROCEL PTY LTD, 52108.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: Accounts comparison page lists minimum deposits of 1 USD, 10 USD and 100 USD. A 29 March 2023 company article maps those to Cent ($1), Standard ($10) and Pro ($100). The live Cent, Standard and Pro pages do not repeat those deposit figures in their specification tables. Homepage says 'Start with just $1'. Because the amount depends on account type, no single minimum is recorded.

other_fees.note: Cent and Standard pages say commission no.
